### Revealing That Beauty Lies Just Beyond the Surface

[ Book Your Demo ][24]

UltraVision™ takes skincare to the next level by combining two technologies into one personalized
treatment. With industry-first ultrasound visualization and unmatched precision, UltraVision™ offers
ultrasound imaging, mapping, and an exclusive Uniform RF Microneedling delivery system. Your
patients will appreciate the precise and personalized results they’ll achieve.


Personalized Treatment Settings
Ultrasound Skin Depth Precision
Colorblind Versatility
Minimal Downtime
Uniform Energy Delivery

Having UltraVision™ in my practice is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made, not only for my

Since 2016, Aesthetics Biomedical® Inc. has pioneered technologies that

Our goal is to provide your customers with personalized, precise, and safe treatments delivering

Complex Science. Custom Results.

## What Customer Say About

## UltraVision^{™}

There is something about UltraVision™ that is special – the downtime is significantly less than
regular microneedling. After multiple treatments, I feel like my makeup just glides over my skin.

I like to call it the Benjamin Button facial. It’s literally my go-to treatment.

**Jennifer Saviano, ABC’s The Bachelor & Bachelor in Paradise**

I recently completed my series of three UltraVision™ treatments and am thrilled with the results. I
am in my 60s but feel like my face makes me look closer to 40. As someone who has tried several
topical products and a few treatments, UltraVision™ is the one that has the most value and impact.
Some treatment areas feel smooth enough I don’t feel the need for injections. After my treatments, I
experience minimal redness that fades quickly. I plan to keep up with my treatments and hope to get
a series to focus on my eye area with the new smaller tip. This is a treatment I’d recommend to
anyone looking for a minimally invasive treatment with maximum results.

**- Karen M., 63 years old**

UltraVision™ is the first aesthetic treatment I have tried and am very happy with the results. After
each treatment, I notice my complexion appears more even and my skin feels tighter. As a busy mom, I
appreciate that there is minimal down time and I can go right back to any kid-related activities the
same day of my treatment, as long as I avoid the sun for twenty-four hours. My provider was able to
personalize the treatment settings to each area of my face and ensured I was comfortable. The
topical numbing cream made it virtually pain free and I loved how the cooling mask applied after
each treatment made for a relaxing experience.

**- Tracey T., 39 years old**

I have now had three treatments with the new device. Having had microneedling with other products
before, I thought I knew what to expect from the treatment, but this treatment was different. First,
I have had little to no redness, bruising, or tightness immediately following treatment. This was
huge, especially since I had appointments/meetings right after the treatments and did not have to
worry about the appearance of my face or having to schedule “down time”. The second difference from
previous treatments is that within two weeks of my first treatment, I noticed a difference: several
of my lines/wrinkles, especially my laugh lines, were not as deep. I could easily see the
improvement in the mirror. I recently was at my hairdresser who asked me what I had been doing, as
she, too, noticed my skin’s improvement. The treatment itself was painless, although you can
definitely feel it. All in all, I’m very happy with the results.

**- Debra P., 67 years old**

Bringing 20+ years of Pro-Collagen expertise beyond the face to deliver the same powerful,
clinically proven results and sensorial experience.

[Shop Now][147]

We Believe In

## Skin Wellness

Our products help keep your skin healthy by supporting its natural barrier and defending against
everyday stressors, like pollution and environmental damage. We always recommend a personalised
routine, with a consultation in-store, in-spa or online, tailored to maximise the health of your
unique complexion.

[Our story][148]
[Close-up of a person's face with a hand applying product, leaving streaks on the cheek.]

## Proven Results

Every ELEMIS formula should make a truly visible difference. We're confident we can achieve this
through rigorous testing to ensure the best possible performance, using powerful actives that are
clinically proven to work.

[Shop Pro-Collagen][149]
[Close-up of a person's blue eye, freckled skin, and a small yellow bump on the cheek.]

## Feel-Good Skincare

ELEMIS is rooted in aromatherapy and spa treatments – so our development process always considers
how aromatics, touch and textures contribute to overall wellbeing. Combining the sensory with our
high-performance ingredients creates a skincare experience that is both results-driven and deeply
relaxing.

[Shop Our Best Sellers][150]
[Close-up of a person's blue eye and freckled cheek with a tear.]

## Transparent Innovation

All of our products are developed in our ELEMIS Innovation Hub in London and manufactured in
England*, with the highest standards in quality and safety. (A few exceptions apply. Please refer to
product packaging for the correct statement of origin.)

[Our Story][151]
[A golden moorland with pools of water and distant misty, snow-capped hills.]

Bringing 20+ years of Pro-Collagen expertise beyond the face to deliver the same powerful,
clinically proven results and sensorial experience.

[Shop Now][147]

We Believe In

## Skin Wellness

Our products help keep your skin healthy by supporting its natural barrier and defending against
everyday stressors, like pollution and environmental damage. We always recommend a personalised
routine, with a consultation in-store, in-spa or online, tailored to maximise the health of your
unique complexion.

[Our story][148]
[Close-up of a person's face with a hand applying product, leaving streaks on the cheek.]

## Proven Results

Every ELEMIS formula should make a truly visible difference. We're confident we can achieve this
through rigorous testing to ensure the best possible performance, using powerful actives that are
clinically proven to work.

[Shop Pro-Collagen][149]
[Close-up of a person's blue eye, freckled skin, and a small yellow bump on the cheek.]

## Feel-Good Skincare

ELEMIS is rooted in aromatherapy and spa treatments – so our development process always considers
how aromatics, touch and textures contribute to overall wellbeing. Combining the sensory with our
high-performance ingredients creates a skincare experience that is both results-driven and deeply
relaxing.

[Shop Our Best Sellers][150]
[Close-up of a person's blue eye and freckled cheek with a tear.]

## Transparent Innovation

All of our products are developed in our ELEMIS Innovation Hub in London and manufactured in
England*, with the highest standards in quality and safety. (A few exceptions apply. Please refer to
product packaging for the correct statement of origin.)

manufacturers globally.

performance aesthetic equipment. Among all aesthetic machine manufacturers in China, ADSS is the

products are accumulatively exported to more than 160 countries around the world, creating great
value for millions of customers !

## Beijing ADSS Development Co.,Ltd

Beijing ADSS Development Co., Ltd.(ADSS) established in July 2005, is the pioneering medical &
aesthetic laser equipment manufacturer and national high-tech enterprise specializing in R&D,
manufacturing, sales, and service of medical aesthetic equipment. Covering a total area of
160,000㎡, headquartered in Beijing with branches around the world, ADSS owns the world-class top
production and research base, located in the scenic Gu'an Industrial Park. ADSS has ranked No.1 in
the annual export volume and the total output value of medical aesthetic equipment in the field of
optoelectronics in China and is listed among the most influential medical aesthetic machine
manufacturers globally.

Based on the latest cutting-edge technology in the industry, with professional R&D capabilities as
the core, ADSS has been deeply involved in the aesthetic industry for more than 20 years and is
committed to providing customers with more cost-effective, safety-guaranteed, and more stable
performance aesthetic equipment. Among all aesthetic machine manufacturers in China, ADSS is the
only one capable of completely independently developing power supply and control systems. ADSS
products are accumulatively exported to more than 160 countries around the world, creating great
value for millions of customers !

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized

Award Categories

Any artifact, creation, art work, product, project or service that involves good design, enhanced
aesthetics, creative ideation, design thinking, superior engineering, and/or original innovation

collections and product families. There are also very special design award categories for
recognizing lifelong achievements of brands, design agencies and individuals.

Omega Particle, the A' Design Award Trophy, designed in Italy, is a tangible and durable reminder of
design excellence achievement, and serves as recognition and evidence of merit for good design. The
A' Design Award Trophy, granted to eligible laureates, is coveted by designers, artists and
architects worldwide.

A' Design Award's Press Room grants prominent press members and leading journalists access to high
resolution images and electronic press kits of the World’s best art works, products, designs and
architecture. Accredited editors will also be able to access profile and portrait images of
award-winning designers, logos of award-winning brands as well as exclusive interviews with
designers regarding their design philosophy and their award-winning works.

[Design Award Press Room][26]
Mission, Vision & Action

A' Design Award and Competition was established to create a global appreciation and awareness for
good design as well as to promote good design practices and principles worldwide. The ultimate aim
of the design accolade is to make the World a better place by promoting, publishing and advertising
good designs in all industries. A' Design Award incentivizes designers, agencies and companies
worldwide to come up with superior products, projects and services that benefit society by annually
recognizing, awarding and celebrating the very best design work from across the globe, consequently
channeling attention of press members, design media, design oriented audiences, distributors and
buyers to award-winning works.

[Design Award Press Room][27]
Get Involved

Connect, network and reach out to the World’s leading designers, artists, architects and
design-oriented brands and institutions by getting involved with A’ Design Award. There are many
ways to connect and collaborate, including but not limited to design award sponsorship, good design
patronage, jury membership and good design activism.

[Get Involved With A' Design Award][28]
Winners’ Kit

A' Design Award winner kit includes everything laureates need for promoting, publicizing and
advertising their award-winning products, projects and services. Winners’ Kit includes the design
award logo, yearbook inclusion, certificate, trophy, gala invitation, exhibition space, design
rankings inclusion, business networking opportunities, promotion and public relations services for
the award-winning design.

[Design Award Winners Kit]

part in the accolade, starting with clear guidelines on how you should prepare your nomination;
standardized presentations are required to ensure all entries are voted on equal grounds. Learn how
to benefit from complimentary preliminary score and presentation improvement services, made
available to all participants without any fees.

[Get Support][30]

Billions of Impressions, Tens of Millions of Pageviews, Tens of Thousands of Registrations, Tens of

Hundreds of Judges, 110+ Categories, 40+ Languages, 17 Years..

[See Big Numbers][31]
Summary

TL;DR : One of the World’s largest design accolades recognizing and promoting good design. Highest
achievement in design, extremely prestigious thanks to grand award jury, blind peer-review process,
ethical evaluation methodology and the design prize. Entries open right now for brands and
individuals.

[Register and Enter Work][32]
Learn More

A' Design Award and Competition has thousands of pages providing in-depth notes, clarifications and
documentation for participating in the design competition, about the design prize and the accolade
in general. Enter the A' Design Award knowledge base and information portal to find everything you
could potentially need to know about the design award before, during or after taking part. Access
frequently asked questions, award methodology, voting mechanism, presentation guidelines and other
content detailing each and every step of design award participation, evaluation and celebration.

[Design Award Information][33]
Featured Competition

The **Future Kitchen Design Awards**, presented by **BOTINKIT** in collaboration with the **A'
Design Award**, invites visionary designers worldwide to reimagine cooking and kitchen spaces
through groundbreaking technology and intelligent design. This prestigious competition seeks
innovative solutions that fuse artificial intelligence, robotics, and human-centric functionality,
transforming traditional culinary methods into seamless digital experiences. Participants have the
opportunity to showcase their creativity across diverse categories, including product design,
architecture, digital interfaces, and innovative service models, with the chance to win cash prizes,
international recognition, exhibition opportunities, and potential internships, all aligning with
BOTINKIT’s mission of shaping the kitchens of tomorrow.

# The PEAR Imaging System

Patients Enhanced and Rejuvenated. DermaQuip skin analysis offers the PEAR Imaging System. You will
be able to look at patients pores, wrinkles, sun damage, texture, oil , bacteria and skin tone all
in 3D Plus. We offer the most advanced aesthetic equipment on the market.

Turn your standard consult into an advanced technological experience no one will forget. Patients
will be coming back for more and actually be excited about improving their skin and looking young
and healthy again. By adding high resolution photography and [3D Plus Skin Analysis][30] to your
practice, you will be able to track the progress of how your patients skin is improving over the
course of months, years and even decades. DermaQuip skin analysis offers the PEAR Imaging System.
You will be able to look at patients pores, wrinkles, sun damage, texture, oil , bacteria and skin
tone all in 3D Plus. We offer the most advanced aesthetic equipment on the market.

### ♔ Promote Brand

Strengthen your brand presence in the global B2B marketplace. FiSuppliers.com helps suppliers
showcase their company, build credibility, and attract potential buyers with a professional business
profile.

### ⊞ Post Products

Easily list and manage your products with detailed descriptions, images, and pricing. Suppliers can
reach a wide audience by displaying their offerings in relevant categories, increasing visibility
and sales opportunities.

### $ Get Traffic

Drive targeted business inquiries with high organic and direct traffic. Our platform optimizes
product listings and supplier profiles to attract serious buyers, ensuring higher engagement and
lead generation.

### ✉ Contact Directly

Buyers and suppliers can communicate without intermediaries, ensuring fast and transparent
negotiations. Direct messaging and inquiry options make it easy to establish business relationships
and close deals efficiently.

FiSuppliers.com is a B2B website connecting buyers and suppliers. Suppliers can post products,
promote their brand, and get traffic, while buyers can contact suppliers directly for seamless
business transactions.

Thailand is a Medical Haven in the World today. In today’s challenging times medical care is at the
forefront of everyone’s thoughts. Will I be safe in Thailand? Will medical costs be manageable? Can
I get the treatment I need in Thailand?

The answer to all these questions is yes – Thailand has just what you need.

We have all been there, visiting a new country when calamity strikes. You have a **sunburn, stepped
on a nail, or cut your hand**. Anything really; calamity strikes without warning. You know there is
a simple fix, but you do not know the local language – nor how to ask for what you need. You can see
a pharmacy close by and it will be a simple matter to go in there and get what you need.

Download our Questions for Pharmacy book and solve all your problems. It is easy to read and has
everything written out for you in Thai and English along with an English pronunciation of the Thai
words. Simple find the right page and show the picture with the Thai words written right there. No

everything written out for you in Thai and English along with an English pronunciation of the Thai
words. Simple find the right page and show the picture with the Thai words written right there. No

# Our Brands

## About Us

## **The Story behind i-Spa Salon & Spa Supplies **

### **We’re here to make life easier so that your business can thrive - Your success is our Goal!**

i-Spa Salon & Spa Supplies was founded with a simple vision – to make life easier for each beauty
salon and spa owner so that their business can thrive.

While experiencing the unique highs and lows of running a number successful day spa's and salon's
for more than 10 years, Lizel & Shaun Harris realised that there was a need for a better type of
supplier in the beauty industry. 

Being a small business owner is tough. Long hours, frustrating issues with staff, difficult
customers… sometimes you feel like you’re all alone. We’ve lived that experience through our time in
the industry and the prior 15 years running and working in similar retail and wholesale businesses.

That’s why we developed i-Spa Salon & Spa Supplies. We want to take away all the pain points of
purchasing beauty supplies – to provide service that delights whether in-store, online or on the
phone; to make ordering and delivery quicker and easier so you have more time for your clients; to
select the best range of products that make your sales soar; and to bring you helpful advice so that
you have the support to achieve success.

In a short period of time, i-Spa Salon & Spa Supplies has made an impact (just see what our
customers are saying on our Google, Facebook and Hello Peter reviews) but we’re just getting
started! Stay tuned for exciting changes in the months ahead!

Whether you’re a Salonpreneur operating from home, a beauty or nail salon or day spa, a large
franchise group, or a training college, you can be sure that i-Spa Salon & Spa Supplies is striving
to make life easier for you.
* ### Fast Delivery & Free Shipping
  
  
  *for orders over R2500
* ### Cruelty Free Products
  
  
* ### Exceptional Customer Service
  
  

## Our Academy

Dedicated to nurturing the success of our industry, i-Spa Beauty Academy offers beauty courses
designed to instill confidence and deliver exceptional results for your career success. Every course
has been designed by the beauty brands that deliver them, to ensure flawless treatment outcomes and
client satisfaction.

We offer personalised training options, for special requests e-mail [training@i-spa.co.za][91]

## Get FREE delivery

#### Orders placed with a value above R2500 will qualify for **FREE*** delivery anywhere in
#### South-Africa.

All orders below R2500 will automatically be charged a flat rate of R120.

*Furniture & equipment does not qualify for free delivery, it will carry an additional charge

Collections can be arranged from our head office in Krugersdorp, Gauteng.

[ More on Ordering & Shippng ][94]

## i-Spa Retail outlet

### **i-Spa's retail division is striving to become SA's Leading retailer of advanced skincare and
### 'salon only' beauty products.**

Over the years we noticed that most beauty retailers say it but don’t actually put customers at the
heart of their operation. We wanted to change this. Our customers are everything to us, we want to
give you a friction-less and a best possible experience because we really appreciate the value each
and every customer add to our business. We believe in truly helping our customers - our customer
service is focused on only one thing and that is to support our customers when they need us. We
treat our customers as individuals and get back to them as soon possible even if they contact us
after office hours.

Complete our complimentary consultation and receive personalised recommendations from our
professional team.

# Our Brands

## About Us

## **The Story behind i-Spa Salon & Spa Supplies **

### **We’re here to make life easier so that your business can thrive - Your success is our Goal!**

i-Spa Salon & Spa Supplies was founded with a simple vision – to make life easier for each beauty
salon and spa owner so that their business can thrive.

While experiencing the unique highs and lows of running a number successful day spa's and salon's
for more than 10 years, Lizel & Shaun Harris realised that there was a need for a better type of
supplier in the beauty industry. 

Being a small business owner is tough. Long hours, frustrating issues with staff, difficult
customers… sometimes you feel like you’re all alone. We’ve lived that experience through our time in
the industry and the prior 15 years running and working in similar retail and wholesale businesses.

That’s why we developed i-Spa Salon & Spa Supplies. We want to take away all the pain points of
purchasing beauty supplies – to provide service that delights whether in-store, online or on the
phone; to make ordering and delivery quicker and easier so you have more time for your clients; to
select the best range of products that make your sales soar; and to bring you helpful advice so that
you have the support to achieve success.

In a short period of time, i-Spa Salon & Spa Supplies has made an impact (just see what our
customers are saying on our Google, Facebook and Hello Peter reviews) but we’re just getting
started! Stay tuned for exciting changes in the months ahead!

Whether you’re a Salonpreneur operating from home, a beauty or nail salon or day spa, a large
franchise group, or a training college, you can be sure that i-Spa Salon & Spa Supplies is striving
to make life easier for you.

### **i-Spa's retail division is striving to become SA's Leading retailer of advanced skincare and

Over the years we noticed that most beauty retailers say it but don’t actually put customers at the
heart of their operation. We wanted to change this. Our customers are everything to us, we want to
give you a friction-less and a best possible experience because we really appreciate the value each
and every customer add to our business. We believe in truly helping our customers - our customer
service is focused on only one thing and that is to support our customers when they need us. We

## **Electronics and Appliances: Online Shopping Dubai, UAE**

Jumbo Electronics is your go-to destination for the latest releases in electronics and home
appliances. Enjoy 24/7 online shopping with doorstep delivery for a seamless experience. Easily
compare products and make informed decisions with our easy product comparison. Take advantage of
regular deals and offers to save more. Shop securely using trusted payment gateways. From mobiles to
smart devices, we offer a wide range of top brands Electronics and Home Appliances to meet all your
needs. Shop smart, shop at Jumbo Electronics!

 

## **A One-Stop Online Shopping Destination for The Latest Mobile Phones**

Find the latest mobile phones at Jumbo Electronics, your trusted online store for smartphones.
Explore top models like the [iPhone 16][246], [iPhone 16 Pro Max][247], and [Samsung Galaxy S25
Ultra][248], packed with advanced AI features. Shop foldable phones like the [Samsung Galaxy Z
Fold6][249], [Motorola Razr 50 Ultra][250], and [Honor Magic V3][251]. Find Dual SIM smartphones,
gaming phones, and models with long-lasting battery life. Capture stunning photos with the best
camera phones. Enjoy easy EMI options for a hassle-free purchase.

 

## **Top Electronics - PCs, TVs, Cameras, and More Shop the Widest Selection Online** 

Get the best deals on personal computers, laptops, iPads, and tablets, including Samsung tablets and
trending models like the iPad ProM4, iPad Air M2, and Samsung Galaxy S9. Shop online for smart TVs,
including OLED, 8K, 4K, and QLED, and brands like Sony, Samsung, LG, TCL, and Hisense. Set up your
home theater system with the best soundbar and avail yourself of exclusive discounts on your
purchase. Explore every photography style with the best digital cameras, action cameras, and drones.

Get the best deals on all the newly launched DSLRs, mirrorless cameras, action cameras, lenses, and
tripods from brands including Canon, Sony, Nikon, Go Pro, [GoPro HERO 13][252], and DJI drones,
[Insta360][253] cameras. Experience the power of the iMac with the M4 chip, stunning 24" Retina
display, up to 1TB storage, and a magic keyboard with a lock key.

 

## **Your Go-To Destination for the Best Laptops: AI, Gaming, Lightweight, and More**

Shop the latest laptops online and find the perfect match for your needs. Discover high-performance
laptops for work, gaming laptops, lightweight laptops, and portable options for students. Choose
from AI-powered models like the MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, and MacBook Pro M4. Whether for
programming, gaming, or everyday tasks, there's a laptop for everyone. Explore top brands like Dell,
HP, Lenovo, ASUS, and Microsoft Surface, alongside options like Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 5, Huawei
MateBook 14, and HP Spectre X360. Enjoy seamless online shopping with easy comparisons, exclusive
deals, and fast delivery. Elevate your tech game today!

 

## **Upgrade Your Home: Enjoy Effortless Online Shopping for Appliances**

Are you looking to create a smart home or upgrade your space with the latest energy-efficient home
appliances? Jumbo Electronics is your one-stop destination for all eco-friendly appliances. Explore
a wide range of small and large appliances, including refrigerators, washing machines, air
conditioners, dishwashers, cooking ranges, kettles, air fryers, coffee makers, microwave ovens, air

designed for convenience, performance, and sustainability. Jumbo Electronics has everything you need
to upgrade to a smarter, greener lifestyle.

# Leafsnap: An Electronic Field Guide

Leafsnap is a series of electronic field guides being developed by researchers from [Columbia
University][14], the [University of Maryland][15], and the [Smithsonian Institution][16]. The free
mobile apps use visual recognition software to help identify tree species from photographs of their
leaves. They contain beautiful high-resolution images of leaves, flowers, fruits, petioles, seeds
and bark.

The original Leafsnap currently includes trees found in the Northeastern United States and Canada,
and will soon grow to include the trees of the entire continental United States. The high-resolution
images in the original app were created by the conservation organization. [Finding Species][17].

This website shows the tree species included in Leafsnap, the collections of its users, and the team
of research volunteers working to produce it.

The Leafsnap UK app includes trees from the United Kingdom with species information and imagery
provided by the Natural History Museum in London. More information can be found on the [Natural
History Museum website][18].

The City College of New York developed and tested curricular materials that use the Leafsnap app to
help middle school students notice, group, and contextualize street trees in the patterns of
evolution. Curricular guide and other educational materials are available from [here][19].

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## About Reszon Diagnostics

Established in 2010, Reszon Diagnostics International Sdn. Bhd. (“Reszon”) is a Malaysia-based
manufacturer and distributor of innovative **in vitro diagnostic (IVD) rapid test kits for
infectious disease detection, ****drug of abuse and pregnancy screening, point-of-care testing
devices **as well as** health monitoring devices.**

Backed by **ISO 13485:2016 quality management system** and **GDPMD certifications**, Reszon is
committed to delivering high-quality, accurate, and user-friendly diagnostic solutions for global
healthcare markets. Our products are trusted by medical professionals worldwide and are supported by
strong in-house R&D as well as strategic collaborations with commercial and academic research
partners.

For over a decade, we have honed our expertise in immunochromatographic assay development and
innovation, bringing these advancements to the commercial market. Guided by our motto, “**Reasoning
Possibilities in Life**,” we are dedicated to creating new opportunities to enhance human health.

## Product Category

### **Rapid Testing Solutions for Medical Diagnostics**

Discover reliable rapid test kits, point-of-care testing (POCT) device and health motoring device
for healthcare providers, point-of-care testing, and self-testing—designed for fast and accurate
diagnostics.

**Rapid Test Kits for Infectious Disease Detection**

Fast, accurate rapid test kits for COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2), Influenza A (Flu A), Influenza B (Flu B),
Dengue, HIV, Typhoid, Lymphatic Filariasis, Hepatitis and Malaria

[Drug of Abuse Rapid Test]

#### **Rapid Test Kits for Drug of Abuse (DOA)/ Substance Misuse Screening**

Rapidly screen for a wide range of illicit and prescription drugs using urine samples. RESZON
multi-drug panels can include adulterant detection and target drug substances —ideal for workplace,
clinical, and rehabilitation drug screening programs.

**Rapid Test Kits for Pregnancy Detection**

Know sooner, plan better with ultra-sensitive pregnancy test. Detect hCG levels as low as 10 mIU/ml
with over 99% accuracy. Get results 5 days before your expected period.

**Health Monitoring Device**

Monitor your health with reliable devices —blood pressure monitor, glucometer, and body composition
analyzers from trusted brands like BEURER, FORA, and CHARDER

**Point-of-Care Testing (POCT) Device**

LabPad Evolution from BioSynex (France), the smart portable testing device made for busy clinician
and general practitioner (GP) like you. Get accurate lab-quality results in minutes – wherever your
patients are.

**Available Tests: **Fibrinogen (FIB Batrox), INR (for patients on AVK therapy), D-DIMER (rule out
DVT & PE) and CRP (inflammation & infection check)

## About Reszon Diagnostics

Established in 2010, Reszon Diagnostics International Sdn. Bhd. (“Reszon”) is a Malaysia-based
manufacturer and distributor of innovative **in vitro diagnostic (IVD) rapid test kits for
infectious disease detection, ****drug of abuse and pregnancy screening, point-of-care testing
devices **as well as** health monitoring devices.**

Backed by **ISO 13485:2016 quality management system** and **GDPMD certifications**, Reszon is
committed to delivering high-quality, accurate, and user-friendly diagnostic solutions for global
healthcare markets. Our products are trusted by medical professionals worldwide and are supported by
strong in-house R&D as well as strategic collaborations with commercial and academic research
partners.

For over a decade, we have honed our expertise in immunochromatographic assay development and
innovation, bringing these advancements to the commercial market. Guided by our motto, “**Reasoning
Possibilities in Life**,” we are dedicated to creating new opportunities to enhance human health.

## Product Category

### **Rapid Testing Solutions for Medical Diagnostics**

Discover reliable rapid test kits, point-of-care testing (POCT) device and health motoring device
for healthcare providers, point-of-care testing, and self-testing—designed for fast and accurate
diagnostics.

**Rapid Test Kits for Infectious Disease Detection**

Fast, accurate rapid test kits for COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2), Influenza A (Flu A), Influenza B (Flu B),
Dengue, HIV, Typhoid, Lymphatic Filariasis, Hepatitis and Malaria

[Drug of Abuse Rapid Test]

#### **Rapid Test Kits for Drug of Abuse (DOA)/ Substance Misuse Screening**

Rapidly screen for a wide range of illicit and prescription drugs using urine samples. RESZON
multi-drug panels can include adulterant detection and target drug substances —ideal for workplace,
clinical, and rehabilitation drug screening programs.

**Rapid Test Kits for Pregnancy Detection**

Know sooner, plan better with ultra-sensitive pregnancy test. Detect hCG levels as low as 10 mIU/ml
with over 99% accuracy. Get results 5 days before your expected period.

**Health Monitoring Device**

Monitor your health with reliable devices —blood pressure monitor, glucometer, and body composition
analyzers from trusted brands like BEURER, FORA, and CHARDER

**Point-of-Care Testing (POCT) Device**

LabPad Evolution from BioSynex (France), the smart portable testing device made for busy clinician
and general practitioner (GP) like you. Get accurate lab-quality results in minutes – wherever your
patients are.

**Available Tests: **Fibrinogen (FIB Batrox), INR (for patients on AVK therapy), D-DIMER (rule out
DVT & PE) and CRP (inflammation & infection check)

### Injectables

Soft-tissue fillers are injected into the skin to temporarily restore facial volume, fill fine
lines, or enhance facial contours.

**BOTOX, XEOMIN, or DYSPORT** – Reduce or diminish facial wrinkles and creases
**JUVEDERM®** – Add volume to plump lips, smooth lines, or lift & contour cheeks
**KYBELLA®** – Enhance facial contouring and minimize a double chin
**PRF PLATELET RICH FIBRIN** – Treat texture, acne scars, hyperpigmentation, fine lines, and
wrinkles
**SCULPTRA®** – FDA-approved, non-invasive treatment that addresses the underlying cause of facial
aging

[Learn More About Injectables][116]

### Skin Tone & Tightening

**[CHEMICAL PEELS][117]** – Exfoliating treatments that resurface the uppermost layer of the skin
[**DERMAPLANING**][118] – Anti-aging/anti-blemish exfoliating
[**INTENSE PULSATING LIGHT**][119] – Photorejuvenation or photofacial treatment designed to reduce
visible skin damage
**[LASER GENESIS][120]** – Laser treatment that evens out skin tone and texture and reduces fine
lines and acne
**[MORPHEUS8][121] **– Radiofrequency with microneedling depths that create collagen to firm and
reduce laxity
[**PDO THREAD LIFT**][122] – Non-surgical facelift that includes progressive rejuvenation techniques
[**ULTHERAPY**][123] – Non-invasive procedure used to jumpstart collagen production

### Custom Skincare

A professional service that combines high-potency ingredients with professional expertise to create
individualized skin care.

**SKINSCOPE** – LED diagnostic designed to assess skin and identify concerns
**COMPLIMENTARY CONSULTATIONS** – Our education at SkinLab is always complimentary. Schedule time to
learn about your skin, what products are right for you, or how to tackle any skin concerns.
**COSMETIC DERMATOLOGY** – Led by renowned board-certified dermatologist, Dr. Georgina Ferzli,
patients can receive expert skincare in a comfortable and accessible environment.

Our goal is to take you from your consultation through your treatment in under an hour and to
deliver brighter, healthier skin. We provide a holistic and personalized approach to skincare that
includes a full range of [skincare services][114] and treatments.

### Medical Facials

Our medical facials are exclusive procedures and formulas developed by SkinCeuticals that leave you
looking your best.

**TRIBECA ESSENTIAL** – OUR CLASSIC TREATMENT FEATURING LASER GENESIS
**TRIBECA ADVANCED SIGNATURE** – OUR MOST COMPREHENSIVE TREATMENT

[Learn More About Medical Facials][115]

### Injectables

Soft-tissue fillers are injected into the skin to temporarily restore facial volume, fill fine
lines, or enhance facial contours.

**BOTOX, XEOMIN, or DYSPORT** – Reduce or diminish facial wrinkles and creases
**JUVEDERM®** – Add volume to plump lips, smooth lines, or lift & contour cheeks
**KYBELLA®** – Enhance facial contouring and minimize a double chin
**PRF PLATELET RICH FIBRIN** – Treat texture, acne scars, hyperpigmentation, fine lines, and
wrinkles
**SCULPTRA®** – FDA-approved, non-invasive treatment that addresses the underlying cause of facial
aging

[Learn More About Injectables][116]

### Skin Tone & Tightening

**[CHEMICAL PEELS][117]** – Exfoliating treatments that resurface the uppermost layer of the skin
[**DERMAPLANING**][118] – Anti-aging/anti-blemish exfoliating
[**INTENSE PULSATING LIGHT**][119] – Photorejuvenation or photofacial treatment designed to reduce
visible skin damage
**[LASER GENESIS][120]** – Laser treatment that evens out skin tone and texture and reduces fine
lines and acne
**[MORPHEUS8][121] **– Radiofrequency with microneedling depths that create collagen to firm and
reduce laxity
[**PDO THREAD LIFT**][122] – Non-surgical facelift that includes progressive rejuvenation techniques
[**ULTHERAPY**][123] – Non-invasive procedure used to jumpstart collagen production

### Custom Skincare

A professional service that combines high-potency ingredients with professional expertise to create
individualized skin care.

**SKINSCOPE** – LED diagnostic designed to assess skin and identify concerns
**COMPLIMENTARY CONSULTATIONS** – Our education at SkinLab is always complimentary. Schedule time to
learn about your skin, what products are right for you, or how to tackle any skin concerns.
**COSMETIC DERMATOLOGY** – Led by renowned board-certified dermatologist, Dr. Georgina Ferzli,
patients can receive expert skincare in a comfortable and accessible environment.

## Viessmann steht für Erfahrung, Qualität und Innovation

Innovationskraft ist der Schlüssel zur Zukunft. Deshalb arbeiten wir seit über 100 Jahren Tag für
Tag daran, die Grenzen des technisch Möglichen neu zu definieren – für unsere Kunden, unsere Partner
und zukünftige Generationen.

Lösungen mit System

## Wir setzen auf ein intelligentes Portfolio

Heizen, Kühlen, Lüften und Strom erzeugen – mit unseren Energie- und Klimalösungen für Neubau und
Modernisierung verfolgen wir einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Intelligente Systemkomponenten sowie
digitale Services gewährleisten hohe Effizienz und Komfort.
* #### Wärme und Strom
  
  Unsere Energie- und Heizlösungen für Wohngebäude gewährleisten ein perfektes Zusammenspiel von
  Wärme und Strom. Das gilt für klassische sowie regenerative Technologien.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][59]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Produkte, einen Mann und eine Frau.]
* #### Klimaanlagen
  
  Optimales Raumklima und hohe Luftqualität – seit 2023 rundet der Bereich Klimaanlagen das
  Viessmann Climate Solutions Produktportfolio ab. Modernste Technologie vereint Effizienz und
  Komfort.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][60]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Vitoclima 300S Klimagerät an der Wand montiert]
* #### Lüftung
  
  Einzelne Räume oder gesamte Gebäude – unsere Lüftungssysteme gewährleisten einen geregelten
  Luftaustausch. Das wirkt sich positiv auf Luftqualität und Gebäudesubstanz aus.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][61]
  [Das Bild zeigt das Ventilation system und ein Mädchen]
* #### Gewerbe und Industrie
  
  Planung, Installation und Wartung – für unsere Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für
  eine wirtschaftliche Versorgung mit Wärme, Dampf und Strom.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][62]
  [Das Bild zeigt eine Industrieanlage im Hintergrund und ein Tablet mit Daten im Vordergrund.]
* #### Digitale Services
  
  Steuerung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung – unsere digitalen Services ebnen den Weg zu noch mehr
  Effizienz und erleichtern sowohl unseren Kunden als auch unseren Partnern den Alltag.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][63]

### Über Viessmann Climate Solutions

1917 als Heiztechnik-Hersteller gegründet, ist Viessmann Climate Solutions heute ein weltweit
führender Anbieter für effiziente und systemische Klima- (Wärme, Wasser- und Luftqualität) und
erneuerbare Energielösungen. Das integrierte Viessmann Climate Solutions Portfolio verbindet
Produkte und Systeme über digitale Plattformen und Dienstleistungen nahtlos und schafft so ein
sicheres und verlässliches Wohlfühlklima für die Nutzer:innen. Viessmann Climate Solutions ist Teil
der Carrier Global Corporation, einem weltweit führenden Anbieter intelligenter Klima- und
Energielösungen.

Viessmann Climate Solutions

# Effiziente und systemische Klima- und Energielösungen

Über uns

## Viessmann steht für Erfahrung, Qualität und Innovation

Innovationskraft ist der Schlüssel zur Zukunft. Deshalb arbeiten wir seit über 100 Jahren Tag für
Tag daran, die Grenzen des technisch Möglichen neu zu definieren – für unsere Kunden, unsere Partner
und zukünftige Generationen.

[ Mehr über unsere Marke erfahren ][58]
[Das Bild zeigt zwei Viessmann Mitarbeiter in der Produktion mit einer Wärmepumpe]
[Das Bild zeigt einen Mitarbeiter bei der Montage in der Produktionsstätte Allendorf.]
[Das Bild zeigt eine Familie und eine Wärmepumpe.]
[Das Bild zeigt das Hauptgebäude in Allendorf (Eder).]
Lösungen mit System

## Wir setzen auf ein intelligentes Portfolio

Heizen, Kühlen, Lüften und Strom erzeugen – mit unseren Energie- und Klimalösungen für Neubau und
Modernisierung verfolgen wir einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Intelligente Systemkomponenten sowie
digitale Services gewährleisten hohe Effizienz und Komfort.
* #### Wärme und Strom
  
  Unsere Energie- und Heizlösungen für Wohngebäude gewährleisten ein perfektes Zusammenspiel von
  Wärme und Strom. Das gilt für klassische sowie regenerative Technologien.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][59]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Produkte, einen Mann und eine Frau.]
* #### Klimaanlagen
  
  Optimales Raumklima und hohe Luftqualität – seit 2023 rundet der Bereich Klimaanlagen das
  Viessmann Climate Solutions Produktportfolio ab. Modernste Technologie vereint Effizienz und
  Komfort.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][60]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Vitoclima 300S Klimagerät an der Wand montiert]
* #### Lüftung
  
  Einzelne Räume oder gesamte Gebäude – unsere Lüftungssysteme gewährleisten einen geregelten
  Luftaustausch. Das wirkt sich positiv auf Luftqualität und Gebäudesubstanz aus.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][61]
  [Das Bild zeigt das Ventilation system und ein Mädchen]
* #### Gewerbe und Industrie
  
  Planung, Installation und Wartung – für unsere Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für
  eine wirtschaftliche Versorgung mit Wärme, Dampf und Strom.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][62]
  [Das Bild zeigt eine Industrieanlage im Hintergrund und ein Tablet mit Daten im Vordergrund.]
* #### Digitale Services
  
  Steuerung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung – unsere digitalen Services ebnen den Weg zu noch mehr
  Effizienz und erleichtern sowohl unseren Kunden als auch unseren Partnern den Alltag.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][63]
  [Das Bild zeigt digitale Dienste auf einem Smartphone für die Energiekontrolle in Häusern.]

[Bild zeigt lachende Mitarbeiterin im Viessmann Werk Allendorf.]
[Das Bild zeigt ein Baumblatt mit Wassertropfen]
Nachhaltigkeit

## Wir leben Nachhaltigkeit

Unsere Herangehensweise an globale Nachhaltigkeitsherausforderungen basiert auf unserem Zweck, eine
lebenswerte Energiezukunft zu sichern. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das Klima und viele andere
Nachhaltigkeitsfragen.

[ Wie wir Nachhaltigkeit umsetzen ][64]
[Das Bild zeigt vier Wintersportlerinnen aus dem Viessmann Team]
Sponsoring

## Wir sind ein Team

Verantwortung zu übernehmen und im Team zu denken, sind wesentliche Bestandteile unserer
Unternehmenskultur. Das zeigt sich auch in unserem Engagement im Sportsponsoring. Seit 1993
unterstützen wir Athleten, Funktionäre sowie Verbände und pflegen enge Partnerschaften.

[ Wie wir uns im Sport engagieren ][65]
[Das Bild zeigt die Konzernzentrale in Allendorf (Eder)]
Standorte

### Wir sind international

Unser regionaler Hauptsitz ist Allendorf (Eder) in Nordhessen aber wir sind global aktiv. Unsere
effizienten Energie- und Klimalösungen sorgen weltweit für eine zuverlässige und komfortable
Versorgung mit Wärme, Kälte, Luft und Energie.

[ Wo du uns findest ][66]
[Das Bild zeigt einen Viessmann Mitarbeiter in der Produktion]
Karriere

### Wenn du mehr willst als einfach nur einen Job

Wir haben große Ziele vor Augen. Um diese zu erreichen, setzen wir unsere vielfältigen Talente ein.
Wer zu Viessmann Climate Solutions gehört, gestaltet die Energiewende mit und trägt dazu bei, den
Klimawandel zu bekämpfen.

[ Dein Job bei Viessmann Climate Solutions ][67]

### Über Viessmann Climate Solutions

1917 als Heiztechnik-Hersteller gegründet, ist Viessmann Climate Solutions heute ein weltweit
führender Anbieter für effiziente und systemische Klima- (Wärme, Wasser- und Luftqualität) und
erneuerbare Energielösungen. Das integrierte Viessmann Climate Solutions Portfolio verbindet
Produkte und Systeme über digitale Plattformen und Dienstleistungen nahtlos und schafft so ein
sicheres und verlässliches Wohlfühlklima für die Nutzer:innen. Viessmann Climate Solutions ist Teil
der Carrier Global Corporation, einem weltweit führenden Anbieter intelligenter Klima- und
Energielösungen.
